buildOutputNote: The initial build output was returned by the execution tool. The retained build-stdout.txt and build-stderr.txt are from a later cached rebuild of the same unchanged context and image. No runtime output was fabricated.
recipeNote: recapture.sh packages the same source inputs and runtime options with Docker create/start and copies artifacts out. The retained run used Docker run directly.
outputNote: capture-stdout.txt and capture-stderr.txt are Docker logs from the retained capture container.
